name: Footage shrinks to big word
what: Your footage fills the frame, then shrinks to a card in the middle; a line of words wiggles in above it, a huge gradient word rises behind it, and a second line wiggles up below; then the card drops out of the bottom and the three texts stay.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f14 the full-frame footage shrinks to half size in an S-curve (with a small undershoot, motion blur); f11-f22 the top line's words drop in and settle (f11, f15, f18); f25-f31 the big word rises behind the card out of a blur (decelerating); f32-f46 the bottom line's words rise and settle (f32, f35, f38); f47-f62 the card drops out of the bottom of the frame (accelerating, blurred); then the texts drift a hair to the end

tracks.name: card shrink
tracks.what: the footage shrinks from full frame to half size, undershooting a little before it settles

tracks.name: top line
tracks.what: three words drop in from above and settle, 3-4 f apart
tracks.easing: expo out (a third of the distance left each frame)

tracks.name: big word
tracks.what: rises behind the card out of a blur and grows a hair

tracks.name: bottom line
tracks.what: three words rise from below and settle, 3 f apart
tracks.easing: expo out (a third of the distance left each frame)

tracks.name: card hold
tracks.what: the card sits still in the middle (the footage plays)

tracks.name: card drop
tracks.what: the card drops out of the bottom of the frame, blurred

tracks.name: drift
tracks.what: the texts settle a hair smaller to the end
